questions.question: Explain two advantages and two disadvantages of a flat organisational structure.

points.text: Advantages of flat structure: faster decision-making (fewer layers to consult), better communication (less distortion), employees have more responsibility and autonomy (improves motivation). Disadvantages: wide span of control means managers may be overstretched, less opportunity for promotion (fewer management levels), may lack clear authority for complex decisions.

questions.question: Describe the difference between centralisation and decentralisation, and give one benefit of each.

points.text: Centralisation: decisions made by senior management at headquarters. Benefit: consistency across all branches/departments, senior leaders have the big picture. Decentralisation: decisions made by local managers. Benefit: faster responses to local conditions, local managers understand their market better, develops leadership skills in junior managers.

questions.question: Evaluate whether a large business should delayer its hierarchical structure.

points.text: Arguments for delayering: removes expensive middle management (cost savings), speeds up communication between top and front line, empowers remaining staff, makes the organisation more agile. Arguments against: loss of experienced middle managers, wider spans of control may overwhelm senior managers, demotivation of remaining staff (more responsibility without more pay), possible loss of specialist
